references.text: Psalm 22:27-31 speaks of the Lord's praise being proclaimed to all nations and all the ends of the earth turning to the Lord, which reflects Jesus' words that the gospel will be preached throughout the whole world.
Mark 14:9 contains a parallel event where Jesus says something similar about the woman who anointed him, stating that what she did will be told as a memorial to her throughout the whole world.

Luke 7:47 can be seen as an indirect reference through the context of forgiveness and love shown by the woman who anointed Jesus' feet, even though the direct action and global testimony are not mentioned.

1 Peter 1:8 reflects the idea of faith without having seen Jesus, which can be linked to the global testimony Jesus mentions in Matthew 26:13, where faith in the gospel will spread throughout the whole world.
